rig.oracles: live OCCT replicad-opencascadejs, live brep-rs archive/brep-rs/pkg, 20 saved FreeCAD results (17 variant refs + 3 baseline), closed forms, and the phase 7 pane in a real headless browser (shipping resolver)

notes: STATUS CONVENTION: the status of a row is what a student gets through the SHIPPING path, the phase 7 pane (translate-p4 + resolve-names.mjs + the real solidcraft wasm, in a real browser; evidence says PANE). Rows tagged [LATENT] or [RIG ONLY] describe kernel/translator behaviour that the pane currently stops with a resolver refusal; their status is what happens when it is reached (the phase 0 rig, evidence says RIG), so a resolver that relaxes those refusals cannot walk into a wrong solid unguarded. Rows tagged [SHIPPING] are the refusals themselves.

CONVENTION NOTE (sequential adjacent blends): OCCT and FreeCAD (the product being replaced) propagate a second fillet along the tangent-continuous chain created by the first, so two rounded edges give a rounded corner plus the next edge; SolidCraft applies the literal mitre (box minus the union of both removal prisms) unless the radii step down by 2 or more, where it follows OCCT. No saved FreeCAD ref covers sequential adjacent edges. Results for sequences are "supported, semantics differ from FreeCAD/OCCT", not oracle-matched, with 8 faces against OCCT's 10. Handing the same edges to the kernel in one call gives the OCCT result.

GUARDS measured on the recorded runs (guard-eval.mjs): G1 post-build face count (one blended edge on a box must add exactly one face) and G2 pre-build extent rule (refuse size >= the smaller face extent perpendicular to the edge; refuse blends on one face that sum to >= its extent) flag 35/35 wrong single-edge fuzz cases and 0/125 correct ones; G3 (refuse a fillet that follows a fillet on an adjacent edge with 1 < b/a < 2) covers all 21 wrong pair cases and also refuses 9 correct ones.

HOW THE PANE WAS RUN: the phase 7 server already running on 127.0.0.1:8801 (identical pane.js hash and the same dist-p7 wasm app as docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/phase7/run.sh builds), driven by playwright-cli session fcspike (not mom) through window.__host.setScript + run({confirmed:true}) (script cases) or translateRaw (ModelDoc cases): contract/fillet-chamfer-evidence/browser-run.mjs -> browser-results*.json (308 runs). The pane runs the REAL shipping resolver (resolve-names.mjs) and no brep-rs; the rig numbers come from the phase 0 translator with brep-rs picks.

REFUSAL SENTENCES: the pane shows the kernel's own first error with a command-list prefix ("round1 (fillet): solidcraft refused it -- solid.fillet: not supported yet: the blend is larger than the neighbouring faces"); the phase 0 rig showed the LAST pick-retry error ("no edge at [...]: the nearest edge is N mm away"), which names the wrong cause and is not what ships. Neither is plain student language; every refusal row says so and none is claimed plain.
